name: reporter_cluster_gauge_L6_boolean_breadth
description: Tests: cs_gauge L6 boolean breadth pattern with two-stage time_agg + agg reduction. Exercises 100/0 encoding and all three breadth variations (Last/Mean, Max/Mean, Mean/Mean).
source:
# ========================================================================
# Gauge L6 Boolean Breadth — Two-Stage Reduction
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === Derived Indicators ===
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
sma_200 = sma(close, 200)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# === Boolean Conditions ===
below_50dma = close < sma_50
above_200dma = close > sma_200
rsi_overbought = rsi_14 > 70
rsi_oversold = rsi_14 < 30
positive_return = daily_ret > 0

# === 100/0 Encoding (not True/False) ===
# cs_gauge(agg=Mean) needs numeric series. 100/0 means the final
# cross-asset Mean is already on 0-100 scale — no extra *100 needed.
below_50dma_pct = 100.0 if below_50dma else 0.0
above_200dma_pct = 100.0 if above_200dma else 0.0
rsi_overbought_pct = 100.0 if rsi_overbought else 0.0
rsi_oversold_pct = 100.0 if rsi_oversold else 0.0
positive_return_pct = 100.0 if positive_return else 0.0

# ========================================================================
# VARIATION 1: Last/Mean — Current breadth snapshot
# time_agg=Last picks each asset's CURRENT state,
# agg=Mean averages across assets = current breadth %
# ========================================================================

# 1a: % of stocks currently below 50-day MA
cs_gauge(title='% Below 50-Day MA', category='01 Breadth Last/Mean: Below 50DMA',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Last,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=below_50dma_pct)

# 1b: % of stocks currently above 200-day MA
cs_gauge(title='% Above 200-Day MA', category='02 Breadth Last/Mean: Above 200DMA',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Last,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=above_200dma_pct)

# 1c: % of stocks with RSI currently overbought (>70)
cs_gauge(title='% RSI Overbought', category='03 Breadth Last/Mean: RSI Overbought',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Last,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1,
    use_traffic_light_colors=True
)(value=rsi_overbought_pct)

# 1d: % of stocks with positive return today
cs_gauge(title='% Positive Return Today', category='04 Breadth Last/Mean: Positive Ret',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Last,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=positive_return_pct)

# ========================================================================
# VARIATION 2: Max/Mean — Fraction that triggered at least once
# time_agg=Max picks each asset's peak 100|0 (= ever flagged),
# agg=Mean = fraction of assets that EVER hit the condition in window
# ========================================================================

# 2a: % of stocks that were EVER below 50-day MA
cs_gauge(title='% Ever Below 50DMA', category='05 Breadth Max/Mean: Ever Below 50DMA',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Max,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=below_50dma_pct)

# 2b: % of stocks that were EVER RSI oversold (<30)
cs_gauge(title='% Ever RSI Oversold', category='06 Breadth Max/Mean: Ever RSI Oversold',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Max,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1,
    categories=['None', 'Some', 'All']
)(value=rsi_oversold_pct)

# 2c: % of stocks that EVER had a positive return day
cs_gauge(title='% Ever Positive Day', category='07 Breadth Max/Mean: Ever Positive',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Max,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=positive_return_pct)

# ========================================================================
# VARIATION 3: Mean/Mean — Time-averaged breadth (period mean)
# time_agg=Mean = average share flagged per asset over time,
# agg=Mean = then average across assets = time-avg breadth
# ========================================================================

# 3a: Average share of time below 50-day MA across assets
cs_gauge(title='Avg Time Below 50DMA', category='08 Breadth Mean/Mean: Avg Below 50DMA',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1
)(value=below_50dma_pct)

# 3b: Average share of time RSI overbought across assets
cs_gauge(title='Avg Time RSI Overbought', category='09 Breadth Mean/Mean: Avg RSI OB',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1,
    use_traffic_light_colors=True
)(value=rsi_overbought_pct)

# 3c: Average share of time above 200-day MA across assets
cs_gauge(title='Avg Time Above 200DMA', category='10 Breadth Mean/Mean: Avg Above 200DMA',
    time_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min=0, max=100,
    value_type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, decimal_places=1,
    categories=['Bearish', 'Neutral', 'Bullish']
)(value=above_200dma_pct)
